decisions.reason: The glass flake spraying system extends the firm's core two-component coating line for corrosion protection. It stays visible on the website, so results look satisfactory and give no trigger for problemistic search.

The low-pressure injection pump has its own page and a documented field application in construction repair. This suggests results meet the aspiration level, and its closeness to the core offer makes it cheap to carry.

This multi-model product line of transfer pumps reuses the proven air motors and fits the established business. It needs little extra slack and serves a growing industry, so there is no reason to drop it.

Fire protection flow monitoring is more peripheral than the other products, but it keeps a dedicated page and supports the firm's digitalization goals. With industry growth providing slack, the firm can carry it while results are still uncertain.
The hydraulic two-component spraying system was launched only in 2024 and is close to the core offer. It is too early to see a shortfall against aspirations, so the firm will keep it.
